items.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary_en: OpenAI released two models, GPT-6.2 Astra (positioned for the hardest professional work) and GPT-6.2 Sol (positioned for efficient everyday tasks). They are available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, per search snippets listing API prices of $8/$40 (Astra) and $2/$10 (Sol) per million input/output tokens.
items.notes: openai.com was not directly fetchable (DNS blocked in session); based on search-result snippets of the official page, date taken from snippet. Verify pricing and details against the page.

items.title: GPT-6.2 system card published on Deployment Safety Hub
items.summary_en: According to the search summary of the system card, Astra is the first model OpenAI has deployed externally that meets the High threshold for AI Self-Improvement under its Preparedness Framework. Reduced cyber refusals are reportedly limited to organizations approved under a program called Daybreak Red.
items.notes: Not directly fetched; claims come from a search-tool summary and may be imprecise. Publication date assumed to match the model launch. Verify against the system card.

items.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary_en: Agents in ChatGPT can make purchases with user approval. Initially limited to ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ in the US with eligible US-issued cards.
items.notes: Search snippet only; page not directly fetched.

items.title: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI announce content partnership
items.summary_en: Le Figaro journalism will be discoverable in ChatGPT through summaries, excerpts and links back to original stories.
items.notes: Search snippet only; page not directly fetched.

items.title: ChatGPT Space rolling out to Plus users
items.summary_en: ChatGPT Space is rolling out globally to Plus users aged 18+. It lets users build interactive pages and presentations and share them so others with access can build on them.
